name: AR-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district lean of R+23
Incumbent Rick Crawford running with a large cash advantage
Democrat Terri Green has minimal fundraising and no outside support
Prediction markets price Republican win at 97%
model.rationale: Crawford is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans heavily Republican, while Green has raised only about $65,000 with little cash on hand. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Republican hold, with no polls or ratings suggesting otherwise.
model.watch: A major late-breaking scandal or unexpected outside spending surge could narrow the margin, though a Democratic win remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Rick Crawford seeks another term in this heavily Republican northeastern Arkansas district, where the partisan lean favors Republicans by more than twenty points. He enters the general election with over a million dollars on hand after being renominated without difficulty. Democrat Terri Green has raised only a small fraction of that amount and has minimal cash available, with no outside spending on either side to change the picture.

Prediction markets give Crawford roughly a 97% chance of winning, and no public polls or expert ratings identify this race as competitive. The Libertarian candidate on the ballot is not expected to be a factor. Everything points to a comfortable Republican hold, with the only real question being the size of Crawford's victory margin.
